entities.summary: Hayley Scamurra is an American professional ice hockey player for the Montreal Victoire of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL), and a member of the United States women's national ice hockey team. She previously played for the Ottawa Charge and Toronto Sceptres of the PWHL.
